EC1: Known other respiratory disorders [OR] or signs for other respiratory disorders (e.g. asthma [OR], lung cancer [OR], sarcoidosis [OR], tuberculosis [OR], lung fibrosis [OR], cystic fibrosis [OR], bronchoectasis).
EC2: Known history of significant inflammatory disease [AND], [NOT] other than COPD (e.g. rheumatoid arthritis [OR] and systemic lupus erythematosus).
EC3: Known to be severely alpha-1-antitrypsin deficient (PI SZ or ZZ)
EC4: Having undergone lung surgery [OR] (e.g. lung resection including lung volume reduction surgery [OR], lung transplant) or subjects scheduled [AND] for surgery.
EC5: Concurrent medication from Visit 1 and for the duration of the study with any of the prohibited medications: monoamine oxidase inhibitors [OR] and tricyclic antidepressants [OR], and ritonavir (a highly potent cytochrome P450 3A4 inhibitor).
EC6: Subjects receiving chronic [OR] or prophylactic antibiotic therapy.
EC7: Serious, uncontrolled disease (including serious psychological disorders) likely to interfere with the study or impact on subject safety.
EC8: Have, in the opinion of the investigator [AND], evidence of alcohol [OR], drug [OR] or solvent abuse.
EC10: History or presence of clinically significant drug sensitivity [OR] or clinically significant allergic reaction to corticosteroids [OR] or salmeterol.
EC11: Moderate [OR] or severe COPD exacerbation (requiring corticosteroids [AND] or increased dosage of corticosteroids [OR] and/or antibiotics [OR] or hospitalization) within the 4 weeks prior to Visit 1
EC12: Lower respiratory tract infection within the 4 weeks prior to Visit 1 .
EC13: Pregnant [OR] or lactating [OR] female and female of childbearing potential.
EC14: Subject is a participating investigator, sub-investigator, study coordinator, or other employee of a participating investigator, or is an immediate family member of the before mentioned. Subject is an employee of GlaxoSmithKline (GSK).
EC15: Subject participated in an investigational drug study within 30 days prior to Visit 1
